task_objective: Exclude durable BLOCK verdicts from stable and testing catalogs, reconcile already-published blocked artifacts, preserve the newest allowed fallback, and prevent both update-detector inputs from repeatedly rebuilding for held-back releases.
design_decisions: Loaded verdicts once per generator or update-check invocation and reused that snapshot throughout each run.

Identified current GitHub releases through the existing repository plus release-ID adapter, while identifying upstream catalog artifacts by canonical GitHub owner/repository, normalized version, and audited SHA-256.
Removed blocked versions from fetched stable and testing entries before merging, and removed a plugin entry entirely when every otherwise-valid release was BLOCKed.
Kept MANUAL_REVIEW, AUDIT_ERROR, PASS, and unknown releases fail-open; only effective classification BLOCK is excluded.
The plan was already committed on dev in d838f34, so the implementation branch inherited it instead of creating a duplicate empty plan commit.

The required origin/dev pull could not be performed because origin exposes only main; the branch was created from the clean local dev at 85ebc44, which already contained the finalized audit-verdicts merge.
